subject: add .kiro folder to .gitignore; enable developers to use kiro while prevent uploading kiro steering files (#404)
reason: The change adds a single line (`.kiro/`) to .gitignore so developers' Kiro steering files aren't committed. It touches no source code, build configuration, or runtime behavior of the valkey-search module; there is no command, reply, replication, or persistence path to exercise.
